channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran missiles target US forces in Jordan after a five-day pause in war
item.description: The US military says it has successfully intercepted a barrage of missiles fired by Iran at its troops in Jordan.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, US carry out strikes on Iran-backed groups in Iraq
item.description: Riyadh says its targeted attacks were done in coordination with the US military.

item.title: Iran war live: US, Saudi forces attack Tehran-aligned groups in Iraq
item.description: Attacks come as Saudi Arabia intercepts drones and Iran warns of 'any action' to maintain its control of Hormuz.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia oil tanker
item.description: The Houthis recently declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea, targeting several tankers.

item.title: Israeli airstrike destroys Gaza City mosque near displacement camp
item.description: Video footage captures an Israeli airstrike hitting Al-Muttaqin Mosque in Gaza City, next to Yarmouk Stadium

item.title: Iran and Oman exchange proposals to manage Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Omani proposal is based on the Strait of Malacca model, where ships that use the strait provide voluntary fees.

item.title: Many feared dead from 7.1-magnitude quake in Kumamoto, Japan
item.description: A powerful 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Kumamoto, Japan, causing widespread damage, injuries and fears of deaths.

item.title: Kyiv warns Iran against escalation after Ukraine’s Caspian Sea attack
item.description: Kyiv claims its Caspian Sea strike targeted Russian warships, denying intent to harm civilian vessels or individuals.

item.title: Iran and US trade strikes, shattering brief lull in fighting
item.description: US Central Command says it intercepted "multiple" ballistic missiles fired by Iran.

item.title: 'A lover of life' - Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
item.description: Families grieved on Monday as they remembered the three people killed in a shooting at a food festival.
